extDescription.message: Detects domain age and risky TLDs/registrars. ⚠️ Privacy: each visited domain is sent to rdap.org — see README before installing.

notChecked.message: Not checked (internal protocol / IP address / localhost)

statusTrustedTld.message: Trusted TLD (gov / edu / mil — no alerts)

statusNotQueried.message: Not queried yet (reload the page to trigger)

statusOk.message: Not a newly registered domain (registered over $1 days ago)

optionsSubtitle.message: Manage lists, threshold, and built-in references

backupHint.message: Download lists and settings as JSON, or restore from a backup file. On import, lists are merged (existing entries are kept).

backupImportSettings.message: Also import settings (threshold, overlay, detection, language)

backupImportNoData.message: No importable data in the file

languageHint.message: Takes effect immediately; new banners / overlays use the new language, but already-open pages need a reload.

privacyIntro.message: The core mechanism of this extension is sending the domains you visit to a third party to look up their registration date — meaning your browsing data does leak. See the "Privacy" section of the README for the full disclosure.

privacySentBody.message: The registrable domain (eTLD+1) of each tab load that misses the local cache. The full URL, query string, and subdomains are NOT sent.

privacyWhereBody.message: rdap.org → HTTP 302 redirect to the domain's registrar RDAP server (your IP + the query are visible to both). .me / .io / .sh / .ac / .bz go directly to rdap.identitydigital.services.

privacyMitigationBody.message: 7-day local cache, whitelist / trusted TLD / private IP / localhost / blacklist hits / chrome:// completely skip RDAP, only the root domain is sent, all HTTPS.

privacyGapsBody.message: No "skip in incognito" toggle, no self-hosted RDAP proxy / domain hashing, no enterprise/intranet mode. Not recommended for M&A targets, unannounced product domains, or sensitive investigation subjects.

privacyReadme.message: If this risk is unacceptable, disable or remove this extension.

whitelistHint.message: Whitelisted domains never trigger alerts; the icon stays as the dim octopus.

blacklistHint.message: Visiting a blacklisted domain shows the red alert banner; the icon turns black.

batchImportHint.message: One domain per line, or comma-separated. Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.

thresholdHint.message: Domains younger than this trigger the red alert banner. Range 1–3650 days, default 30.

overlayHint.message: Replace the top banner with a semi-transparent overlay that's harder to miss.

overlayBlacklistSub.message: Applies to blacklist alerts (red). Highest risk, so the top banner is also shown — visible after dismissing the overlay. On by default.

overlayYoungSub.message: Applies to young-domain alerts (red). High risk, so the top banner is also shown — visible after dismissing the overlay.

overlayHighRiskTldSub.message: Applies to high-risk TLD reminders (orange). The overlay replaces the top banner.

cacheHint.message: RDAP results are cached for 7 days. Clearing forces a re-query on the next visit.

statsHint.message: Resets when the browser closes. Whitelist, trusted TLD, and cache hits each save one RDAP query.

trustedHint.message: Domains matching this list are passed through without an RDAP query.

highRiskTldHint.message: Matches show an orange reminder banner and turn the icon orange. The built-in list is based on Spamhaus reports — you can add custom entries or disable any built-in.

inputPlaceholderTld.message: Enter a TLD without the dot, e.g. xyz / top

disabledTldsHint.message: Built-in TLDs you've disabled. Click ↻ to restore them.

registrarHint.message: Matches show an orange "high-risk registrar" hint in the popup but do not trigger a banner on their own (to avoid false positives). This list is opinionated; treat it as a hint only.

batchNoValid.message: No valid domains to add (check format)

thresholdSaved.message: Saved ($1 days) — applies on next visit

lockHint.message: When on, these alerts can't be closed, skipped, or whitelisted from the web page or this extension's popup — they can only be changed from this options page (young domains also clear automatically once they pass the threshold). Designed so a family member can set it up and stop careless dismissals.

lockBlacklistSub.message: Blacklist alerts can't be closed on the page, and the popup's "Remove from blacklist" button is disabled. They only clear by removing the domain from the blacklist here.

lockYoungSub.message: Alerts for domains below the threshold can't be closed on the page, and the popup's "Add to whitelist" button is disabled. They clear by whitelisting the domain here, or once the domain is older than the threshold.

lockEnabled.message: Lock enabled (alerts can't be dismissed on the page)

lockDisabled.message: Disabled (alerts can be dismissed on the page)

statsNoData.message: No data yet (visit a few sites and come back)

statsHitRate.message: Hit rate $1% — of $2 checks, $3 saved an RDAP query

contentWarnBlacklist.message: Warning: $1 is on your blacklist — marked as malicious!

contentWarnYoung.message: Warning: $1 is less than $2 days old (registered $3, $4 days ago) — very likely a recently set-up phishing/scam site. Real banks, payment, shopping and government sites rarely use such new domains. If it asks for your card number, online-banking login, a store payment code, or any payment, stop now.

contentWarnHighRiskTld.message: Reminder: $1 uses $2, a TLD often registered in bulk and abused for scams. Before entering credentials, paying by card, or making a store payment, double-check this is the official site you meant to visit.

warningLockedNote.message: This alert is locked and can't be closed or skipped from this page. If you're sure it's safe, unlock it from the extension's options page (young domains also clear automatically once they pass the threshold).

popupLockedNote.message: This domain is locked — change the lists from the options page.

popupLockedNoteYoung.message: This domain is locked — change the lists from the options page (young domains also clear once past the threshold).

lookupHint.message: Paste a suspicious link from LINE / SMS to see its risk signals before clicking.

lookupPlaceholder.message: Paste a URL or domain, e.g. example.com

lookupEmpty.message: Enter a URL or domain first.

lookupShortener.message: ⚠️ This is a URL shortener. BRO can only see the shortener itself, not where it ultimately leads — be extra careful, and don't enter credentials or payment info when the destination is unknown.

lookupDisclaimer.message: Shows currently-visible risk signals only — not a scam verdict. No warning does not mean safe.

evidenceTldDetail.message: $1 is often registered in bulk and abused for scams

evidenceRedactedDetail.message: Deliberately hidden (WHOIS redacted); legitimate businesses rarely do this

evidenceBlacklistDetail.message: You previously added this domain to your blacklist

explainYoung.message: Real banks, payment, and shopping sites don't use brand-new domains. Don't enter credentials or card details here; if you arrived via a link, close it and use the official app or type the official URL yourself.

explainBlacklist.message: You marked this domain as malicious. Don't enter any data here unless you're sure it's safe.

explainHighRiskTld.message: This isn't necessarily a scam, but be careful. Before entering credentials or paying, confirm the spelling matches the official site exactly.

oddNameHint.message: When the main domain (excluding the TLD) is longer than 10 characters or contains a hyphen "-", show an orange reminder banner at the top of the page. Scam sites often use such spellings to imitate real ones. This is a purely structural text check — no extra data is sent (no RDAP), and there is no overlay option. Off by default.

oddNameSub.message: Matches show an orange reminder banner (reminder level, dismissible). Internationalized domains (IDN / punycode starting with "xn--") are skipped to avoid mass false positives.

oddNameEnabled.message: Enabled (reminds when the main domain is too long or hyphenated)

oddNameFlagSaved.message: Saved "Detect odd domain names" ($1) — applies on next visit

contentWarnOddName.message: Reminder: the main domain of $1 is $2 — scam sites often use such spellings to impersonate real ones. Before entering credentials, paying by card, or making a store payment, double-check this is the official site you meant to visit.

explainOddName.message: This isn't necessarily a scam, but main-domain spellings like this (very long or hyphenated) are often used to impersonate well-known sites. Before entering credentials or paying, check the URL character by character against the official one; if you arrived via a link, use the official app or type the official URL yourself.

lookupStatusOddName.message: ⚠️ Odd domain (long or hyphenated main domain — caution)

brandSpoofHint.message: When a subdomain contains a well-known brand name but the actual registrable domain has nothing to do with that brand (e.g. paypal.com.evil.xyz — the real site is evil.xyz), an orange reminder banner is shown at the top of the page. This is the most common trick phishing sites use to make a URL "look official". Roughly 40 frequently-impersonated brands are built in (Taiwanese banks / shopping / utilities / telecom plus major global sites). Matching is purely local — no extra data is sent — and there is no overlay option. On by default.

brandSpoofSub.message: Matches show an orange reminder banner (reminder level, dismissible). Only whole subdomain labels are compared, and a brand's own domains are never flagged; generic-word brands (LINE, Apple…) additionally require a domain-mimicry context such as ".com / .tw" to reduce false positives.

brandSpoofEnabled.message: Enabled (reminds when a subdomain carries a brand name)

brandSpoofFlagSaved.message: Saved "Detect brand-spoofing subdomains" ($1) — applies on next visit

contentWarnBrandSpoof.message: Warning: this page's address contains "$2", but the actual site is $1 — not an official $3 site (the official domain is $4). Scammers often disguise fake sites this way. Do not enter credentials, card numbers, or make payments.

overlayTitleBrandSpoof.message: Warning: address may impersonate a brand

explainBrandSpoof.message: Legitimate sites never hide their brand name inside someone else's subdomain — this is almost certainly an impersonated address. Leave this page; to use the service, open the official app or type the official URL yourself, and don't click any links on this page.

evidenceBrandSpoofDetail.message: The subdomain carries "$1", but this site's domain is unrelated to $2's official domain ($3)

lookupStatusBrandSpoof.message: ⚠️ Address may impersonate $1 (official domain: $2) — be very careful

popupStatusBrandSpoof.message: ⚠️ Address may impersonate $1 (official domain: $2) — be very careful

statusWellKnown.message: ✅ Well-known site (built-in allowlist — passed, no lookup sent)

lookupStatusWellKnown.message: ✅ Well-known site (built-in allowlist — passed, no lookup sent)

allowlistHint.message: About 2,900 domains validated by real user traffic (Chrome UX Report: Taiwan top 5,000 + global top 1,000, run through seven filters: cross-month persistence, multi-tenant hosting, high-risk TLDs, adult/piracy/gambling content categories, URL shorteners and storefront builders, and the 165 anti-fraud suspended-domain list). Matching domains pass immediately — no RDAP lookup, and brand-spoofing / odd-name detection is skipped too — fewer false alarms and less privacy leakage at once. Note: being on the list reflects traffic and stability, not an endorsement; your own blacklist always takes precedence. On by default.

allowlistSub.message: Matching domains pass immediately (translucent icon, no reminders). The list is generated at build time and ships with each release — nothing is downloaded at runtime.

allowlistEnabled.message: Enabled (well-known sites pass without RDAP lookups)

allowlistFlagSaved.message: Saved "Built-in well-known-site allowlist" ($1) — applies on next visit

addDomainInvalid.message: Couldn't parse this as a domain (enter something like example.com — IP addresses or single words are not accepted)

popupLockedNoteIndeterminate.message: Can't confirm this domain's registration date right now (RDAP lookup failed). For safety, whitelisting is blocked while locked — try again later, or unlock from the options page.
